AboutBlock.title: About PVB
AboutBlock.text: The company specializes in supplying high-quality equipment and components for the oil and gas industry. We offer a full range of products, including valves, pumps, compressors, pipes, and other essential components required for the successful and safe operation of leading companies such as Gazprom Neft, Rosneft, Lukoil, Sibur, and other key players in the industry.
